input.quote: 18.14 Counterparts; Other Matters. This Agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original, and all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument.
input.rationale: The Agreement has no insurance covenant anywhere: the only "insurance" references are freight/insurance costs and health insurance payers inside the Net Sales definition (p0101, p0102), and Article 16 (indemnification and recalls) contains no insurance support for Array's indemnities. We therefore insert a short insurance provision at the fallback level (E&O USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy USD 2,000,000) at the end of the General Provisions, keeping the change to the minimum needed and leaving the preferred CGL, workers' compensation and certificate elements out of scope of this fallback target.

proposal.summary: Insert a short insurance covenant (E&O USD 1M; cyber/privacy USD 2M) as Section 18.15.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no insurance covenant, so we have added a short provision requiring Array to carry errors and omissions cover of USD 1,000,000 and cyber and privacy cover of USD 2,000,000. This is our fallback insurance position and supports Array's indemnity obligations in Article 16.

ops.text: Insurance. Array shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 and cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
